vars.name: sides
vars.expr: shuffle([a, a, a] if t == 0 else ([a, a, b] if t == 1 else [a, b, c]))

constraints: t != 2 or (a != b and b != c and a != c)

task.prompt: Trójkąt ma boki długości @{sides[0]} @{un}, @{sides[1]} @{un} i @{sides[2]} @{un}. Wybierz najdokładniejszą nazwę tego trójkąta.

value.$expr: ((['a'] if (sides[0] == sides[1] and sides[1] == sides[2]) else []) + (['b'] if ((sides[0] == sides[1] or sides[1] == sides[2] or sides[0] == sides[2]) and not (sides[0] == sides[1] and sides[1] == sides[2])) else []) + (['c'] if (sides[0] != sides[1] and sides[1] != sides[2] and sides[0] != sides[2]) else []))[0]

steps.text: Porównaj długości boków: wszystkie równe – równoboczny; dwa równe – równoramienny; wszystkie różne – różnoboczny.

options.correct: (sides[0] == sides[1] or sides[1] == sides[2] or sides[0] == sides[2]) and not (sides[0] == sides[1] and sides[1] == sides[2])
sides[0] != sides[1] and sides[1] != sides[2] and sides[0] != sides[2]
